task_description: Enable peer-to-peer voice connectivity across networks by making WiFi Direct the primary discovery mechanism instead of relying on LAN-based UDP broadcast.

patterns.state_flow: Private MutableStateFlow + public StateFlow via asStateFlow()
patterns.retry: repeat() with exponential backoff, state verification
patterns.logging: logD{}, logW{}, logE({}, exception) from util/Logger.kt
patterns.config: All timing constants in AppConfig nested objects

existing_implementations.description: WiFi Direct infrastructure already fully implemented in WiFiDirectManager with peer discovery, group creation, connection management. MeshNetworkManager uses LAN UDP broadcast for discovery which fails without shared network. The integration point is in ConnectionCoordinator which currently handles WiFi Direct events but doesn't prioritize it.

key_findings.wifi_direct_status: Fully implemented but not used as primary discovery
key_findings.mesh_discovery: Uses LAN broadcast which only works on same network
key_findings.group_code_integration: Needs to be added to WiFi Direct service discovery
